name: persistent-memory-spike
description: Feasibility plugin for connecting ChatGPT or Codex to a read-only persistent-memory MCP backed by synthetic SQLite data.

interface.longDescription: Temporary feasibility plugin that connects to a remote MCP server exposing memory_status, memory_get, and memory_search over a synthetic SQLite demo backend. It exposes no write tool and does not contain personal memory.
interface.defaultPrompt: Check the persistent memory MCP status and search the synthetic demo memory if useful.
